children: traded higher in the premarket on Thursday after the FDA approved a supplemental New Drug Application, clearing a label update for its cancer therapy Ibtrozi to include new mid-stage trial data.

Based on data from the company’s Phase 2 TRUST-I and TRUST-II studies, the regulator granted full approval for Ibtrozi in 2025 to treat patients with ROS1-positive (ROS1+) non-small cell lung cancer, which accounts for about 2% of all NSCLC cases.

The revised label, as approved by the FDA, indicated an updated median duration of response of 49.7 months found in TKI treatment-naïve patients in the China-based TRUST-I trial, indicating over four years of long-term clinical benefit, the company said.
There were no modifications to the safety section of the label, according to Nuvation Bio
. "This approval is a significant milestone for IBTROZI because this data is now part of the FDA-approved label, something physicians and patients can turn to directly," added CEO David Hung.
The company markets the ROS1 inhibitor in partnership with Innovent Biologics

title: Nuvation Bio rises on FDA label update for Ibtrozi
